entities.name: Query protein (327 aa)
observations: Sequence-derived: 327 aa; estimated mass 36.54 kDa, pI 5.09, GRAVY −0.400, instability index 17.97.
Best reference is reviewed Streptococcus pyogenes dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase UniProt Q8P2D2: 74.7% identity and 100% query coverage (E=6.58e−177).

Strongly inferred function: Mg2+-dependent nucleoside triphosphate pyrophosphatase, likely preferring XTP, dITP, and ITP; proposed cellular role is nucleotide-pool sanitization. Direct activity on this query was not measured. Reference is annotated homodimer and cytosolic.
